import math, time, numpy as np
from build123d import *

# ---- gear pair parameters (mm) ----
MOD   = 3.0
ALPHA = math.radians(20.0)
Z_P, Z_W = 20, 30
BACKLASH = 0.3            # total, along pitch line -> 0.15 mm off each tooth thickness
GAM_P = math.atan2(Z_P, Z_W)          # pinion pitch cone half angle
GAM_W = math.atan2(Z_W, Z_P)
AO    = MOD*Z_W/2/math.sin(GAM_W)     # outer cone distance
FW    = 18.0                          # face width (~Ao/3)
AI    = AO - FW

def inv(a): return math.tan(a)-a

def tooth_face(zt, gam, s):
    """Planar tooth cross-section at cone distance s*AO, Tredgold equivalent involute."""
    Rv   = MOD*zt/(2*math.cos(gam));  Rvb = Rv*math.cos(ALPHA)
    Rtip = Rv+MOD;                    Rroot = Rv-1.25*MOD
    t    = math.pi*MOD/2 - BACKLASH/2
    psi0 = t/(2*Rv) + inv(ALPHA)
    def th_dev(rho):
        r = max(rho, Rvb); phi = math.acos(Rvb/r); return psi0 - inv(phi)
    radii = [Rroot-0.8] + list(np.linspace(max(Rroot,Rvb), Rtip, 14))
    Rp, zo = AO*math.sin(gam), AO*math.cos(gam)
    def pt(rho, sgn):
        d  = rho-Rv; th = sgn*th_dev(rho)/math.cos(gam)
        r  = Rp + d*math.cos(gam); zz = zo - d*math.sin(gam)
        a  = (r*math.cos(th)-Rp)*math.cos(gam) - (zz-zo)*math.sin(gam)
        b  = r*math.sin(th)
        return (a*s, b*s)
    pts = [pt(r, +1) for r in radii] + [pt(r, -1) for r in reversed(radii)]
    e1  = Vector(math.cos(gam), 0, -math.sin(gam))
    nrm = Vector(math.sin(gam), 0,  math.cos(gam))
    pl  = Plane(origin=(Rp*s, 0, zo*s), x_dir=e1, z_dir=nrm)
    return pl * Polygon(*pts, align=None)

def make_gear(zt, gam):
    rr = lambda A: A*math.sin(gam) - 1.25*MOD*math.cos(gam)
    zr = lambda A: A*math.cos(gam) + 1.25*MOD*math.sin(gam)
    prof = Polygon((0,zr(AI)), (rr(AI),zr(AI)), (rr(AO),zr(AO)), (0,zr(AO)), align=None)
    blank = revolve(Plane.XZ*prof, Axis.Z, 360)
    tooth = loft((tooth_face(zt,gam,1.0), tooth_face(zt,gam,AI/AO)))
    g = blank
    for k in range(zt):
        g = g + Rot(0,0,k*360.0/zt)*tooth
    return g

t0=time.time(); pinion_raw = make_gear(Z_P, GAM_P); print("build s", round(time.time()-t0,1))
print("bbox mm", pinion_raw.bounding_box())
print("volume mm^3", round(pinion_raw.volume,1), "solids", len(pinion_raw.solids()))
print("Ao", round(AO,3), "gam_p deg", round(math.degrees(GAM_P),3), "d_p", MOD*Z_P)

t0=time.time()
wheel_raw = make_gear(Z_W, GAM_W)
print("wheel build s", round(time.time()-t0,1), "solids", len(wheel_raw.solids()))
print("wheel bbox", wheel_raw.bounding_box())
# wheel axis -> +x, and rotate about own axis so a tooth SPACE faces the contact line
PHASE_W = 180.0 + 180.0/Z_W          # contact line lies at local theta=180 deg
wheel_g = Rot(0,90,0) * (Rot(0,0,PHASE_W) * wheel_raw)
pinion_g = pinion_raw                # tooth centred on theta=0 -> on the contact line
inter = pinion_g & wheel_g
print("interference volume mm^3", 0.0 if len(inter.solids())==0 else inter.volume)

from OCP.BRepExtrema import BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape
d = BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape(pinion_g.wrapped, wheel_g.wrapped)
d.Perform()
print("min gap pinion-wheel  mm =", round(d.Value(),4),
      " | expected normal backlash = 0.3*cos20 =", round(0.3*math.cos(ALPHA),4))
p1,p2 = d.PointOnShape1(1), d.PointOnShape2(1)
print("closest pts", (round(p1.X(),2),round(p1.Y(),2),round(p1.Z(),2)),
                     (round(p2.X(),2),round(p2.Y(),2),round(p2.Z(),2)))

from OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier
from OCP.gp import gp_Pnt
from OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_OUT

def inside(solid, x,y,z, tol=1e-7):
    c = BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier(solid.wrapped, gp_Pnt(x,y,z), tol)
    return c.State() != TopAbs_OUT

def arc_thickness(solid, gam, A):
    """circular tooth thickness on the pitch cone at cone distance A, gear on +z axis, tooth at th=0"""
    r, z = A*math.sin(gam), A*math.cos(gam)
    assert inside(solid, r,0,z), "pitch point not in material"
    hi = math.radians(360/ (Z_P if gam<math.pi/4 else Z_W) / 2)
    lo = 0.0
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5*(lo+hi)
        if inside(solid, r*math.cos(mid), r*math.sin(mid), z): lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    return 2*lo*r

A_meas = AO - 0.5
s = A_meas/AO
t_p = arc_thickness(pinion_raw, GAM_P, A_meas)
t_w = arc_thickness(wheel_raw,  GAM_W, A_meas)
t_th = math.pi*MOD/2*s
print(f"section at cone distance {A_meas:.2f} mm (s={s:.4f})")
print(f"pinion thickness {t_p:.4f}  wheel {t_w:.4f}  full-thickness ref {t_th:.4f}")
print(f"backlash along pitch line at this section = {2*t_th-t_p-t_w:.4f} mm ; scaled to outer = {(2*t_th-t_p-t_w)/s:.4f} mm (target 0.3)")

LX,LY,LZ = 160.0,140.0,120.0          # cavity, mm
TW  = 8.0                              # wall thickness the bore passes through
RSH_P, RSH_W = 10.0, 12.0              # shaft radii
CLR = 4.0                              # radial oil clearance in each bore
RB_P, RB_W = RSH_P+CLR, RSH_W+CLR

def cyl_along(axis, a0, a1, r):
    c = Pos(0,0,(a0+a1)/2) * Cylinder(radius=r, height=a1-a0)
    return c if axis=="z" else Rot(0,90,0)*c

box      = Box(LX,LY,LZ)
bore_p   = cyl_along("z", LZ/2, LZ/2+TW, RB_P)
bore_w   = cyl_along("x", LX/2, LX/2+TW, RB_W)
shaft_p  = cyl_along("z", 32.0, LZ/2+TW, RSH_P)
shaft_w  = cyl_along("x", 20.0, LX/2+TW, RSH_W)
pin_asm  = pinion_g + shaft_p
whl_asm  = wheel_g  + shaft_w
t0=time.time()
fluid = (box + bore_p + bore_w) - pin_asm - whl_asm
print("cut s", round(time.time()-t0,1), "solids", len(fluid.solids()), "faces", len(fluid.faces()))
print("fluid volume mm^3", round(fluid.volume,1), " box alone", LX*LY*LZ)
print("bbox", fluid.bounding_box())
